title: Backup Archaeology
story: Someone deleted the status page and left behind a tar archive labeled definitely-current-v2-final. Restore it before anyone asks what v1 was.
objective: Extract /backups/status-site.tar into /restore so /restore/index.html and /restore/assets/status.txt are restored.
hints: tar works with file archives; x extracts and f names the archive file.
The -C option chooses the destination directory.
explanation: tar bundles directory trees into one archive. -x extracts, -f selects the archive, and -C changes the extraction destination.
